title: Body Fat Scale Hydration vs Weight Swing
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bodycomp:reading
| stats avg(weight_delta_kg) as avg_weight_delta_kg avg(hydration_pct) as avg_hydration_pct by day_of_week
| sort 0 - avg_weight_delta_kg
description: Ranks days of weeks by weight swing with hydration context.
value: Hydration context helps keep normal fluid swings from being misread as body-composition changes.
implementation: Send weight swing with hydration context events to `index=personal` and keep `day_of_week` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of weight swing with hydration context by days of week.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which days of weeks stand out most for weight swing with hydration context.
